verdict.rationale: OpenHands' site describes an automation that watches for new bugs or incidents, suggests severity, and routes the issue to the right owner. That covers every element of the story, and it is backed by the documented ability to run automations in response to webhook events from GitHub, Linear and similar tools. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on how severity is determined and how owners are mapped and routed, plus independent or hands-on corroboration that the triage automation works as described.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have incoming issues automatically triaged with severity suggested and routed to the right owner

citations.quote: Watch for new bugs or incidents, gather logs and recent changes, suggest severity, and route the issue to the right owner.
Create automations and workflows that integrate with Slack, GitHub, Linear, and more. Run on a schedule or in response to webhook events
